programme.title: Breaking into the Game: Beginners
programme.desc: Shot at The Club at Ibis, Martin Hall's new series is the definitive video golf instruction piece for beginners, providing a solid foundation for new golfers of any age.

programme.title: Build a Better Game: Head to Toe With Martin Hall
programme.sub-title: Build a Better Game: Head to Toe With Martin Hall
programme.desc: The feet are pivotal in the swing for balance and proper weight shift; Martin explains how the feet should sequence during the swing and offers drills for proper movement and balance.

programme.title: Build a Better Game: Head to Toe With Martin Hall
programme.sub-title: Build a Better Game: Head to Toe With Martin Hall
programme.desc: Martin shows how the knees should flex and straighten throughout the swing to maintain power and balance.

programme.title: Build a Better Game: Bunkers
programme.desc: Sharing some tools, techniques and drills for any bunker shot.

programme.title: Build a Better Game: Bunkers
programme.desc: Sharing tips on good tempo and uneven lies, Martin Hall helps prepare players for sand traps.

programme.title: Golf VS
programme.desc: Dallas Stars center Tyler Seguin shares different shots that he uses on the ice, specifically the slap shot.

programme.title: Golf VS
programme.sub-title: Golf vs. Pole Vaulting -- Mando Duplantis
programme.desc: From the differences in sports training to the similarities, join Chris Como as he meets some of the world's best athletes to learn how they prepare and how their skills might translate to the golf course.

programme.title: Golf VS
programme.sub-title: Golf Vs Snowboarding: Shaun White Part 1
programme.desc: Olympic gold medalist Shaun White shares how the basics of snowboarding can translate to the golf swing.

programme.title: Golf VS
programme.sub-title: Golf Vs Snowboarding: Shaun White Part 2
programme.desc: Olympic gold medalist Shaun White shares how snowboarding moves like backflips and complex tricks can translate to the golf swing.

programme.title: Me and My Golf
programme.desc: Andy and Piers want to get the most out of the driver. They demonstrate what the pros look like at impact and share what to do to get into that position.

programme.title: Me and My Golf
programme.desc: Andy Proudman and Piers Ward cover all things long game from fairway metals to hybrids and even how to master the dreaded long irons. They also teach how finding the low point in the swing helps create consistent strikes.

programme.title: Me and My Golf
programme.desc: Andy Proudman and Piers Ward explain the big three in iron play: how to control distance, accuracy, and trajectory on shots. They also show a footwork drill to help ball striking and what to do to work the ball into those tucked pins.

programme.title: Me and My Golf
programme.desc: Andy Proudman and Piers Ward explain how to dial in distances with short irons and how to hit them on line every time; they also explain the bounce angle and how to choose the right amount.

programme.title: Me and My Golf
programme.desc: Andy and Piers show how to play a variety of shots around the green, including the high spinning chip, low runner, and many more. They also explain the importance of focusing on a landing zone when hitting greenside shots.

programme.title: Me and My Golf
programme.desc: Andy and Piers explain the necessary fundamentals to hit effective greenside and fairway bunker shots. They also explain how to hit it close from one of the most feared shots in the game, the 30-40-yard bunker shot.

programme.title: Me and My Golf
programme.desc: Me and My Golf's Andy and Piers explain how to master judging speed and reads on the greens. They also demonstrate the proper mechanics for hitting it solid and making those clutch putts.

programme.title: Me and My Golf
programme.desc: Andy and Piers explain how to master different lies on the course, featuring the buried lie, sitting up lie, and flyer lie.

programme.title: Me and My Golf
programme.desc: Andy and Piers explain that the best play isn't always the hero shot. They demonstrate how save strokes by hitting over, under, and around trouble.

programme.title: Me and My Golf
programme.desc: Andy and Piers explain how to save strokes by thinking around the course; they'll demonstrate how to take advantage of both sides of the tee-box and the importance of a good pre-shot routine.

programme.title: Playing Lessons
programme.desc: PGA winner Kevin Chappell plays the final stretch of iconic Bay Hill with renowned instructor Sean Foley; how Chappell finds the fairway when he needs to and makes putts under pressure.

programme.title: Playing Lessons
programme.desc: The 2017 RBC Heritage winner Wesley Bryan shares his best instruction tips and drills. Bryan breaks down how he became one of the Tour's best from inside 100 yards and how he executes from varying lies around the golf course.

programme.title: Playing Lessons
programme.desc: Three-time winner on the PGA TOUR Brendan Steele welcomes Sean Foley to Shady Canyon, where Steele highlights all facets of his game. From exceptional distance and accuracy off the tee, to great iron play to a unique approach around the greens.

programme.title: Playing Lessons
programme.desc: Sean Foley plays alongside Shubhankar Sharma to discover strategies and techniques that work for him on the big stage, and to show viewers what they can incorporate on their home courses.

programme.title: Playing Lessons
programme.desc: Sean Foley visits his former student and former world number one ranked amateur Ollie Schniederjans in Atlanta, Georgia. Ollie, discusses his ability to launch the ball over 300 yards and how to convert important putts from inside 10 feet.

programme.title: Playing Lessons
programme.desc: Ladies European Tour winner Anne van Dam demonstrates how her golf swing plays to her advantage with length and accuracy.

programme.title: Playing Lessons
programme.desc: PGA TOUR winner Lanto Griffin tees it up at TPC Sawgrass to share on-course strategies on some iconic holes. Plus, he goes in-depth on his green reading and putting process.

programme.title: Playing Lessons
programme.desc: 2020 AIG Women's Open champion Sophia Popov shares her tips and strategies that led to her major victory. Sophia gives insights on how to hit accurate approach shots when in between yardages. She also goes in depth on her putting process.

programme.title: Playing Lessons
programme.desc: PGA Tour winner and 2018 Rookie of the Year, Aaron Wise joins Bones on the course to share his tips and strategies for optimum success.

programme.title: Playing Lessons
programme.desc: Celine goes in depth on how she determines targets and shot shapes both off the tee and into the green.

programme.title: Playing Lessons
programme.desc: Celine goes in depth on her Par 5 strategy to optimize her chances for scoring.
